name: Distributing (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Price +1,500 gp; Weight -5lbs.

DESCRIPTION

These sets of armor were created to make traveling light go further by ensuring weight is always perfectly distributed to its wearer’s body. While wearing a set of distributing armor you treat your light and medium loads as your light load for the purpose of encumbrance penalties. In addition you never need to make a constitution check to avoid non-lethal damage during a hustle or forced march, though you become fatigued after 10 hours of such activities.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ant haul
